info.name: Sportradar Push Feeds Competitors NHL Push API

params.name: access_level
params.description: Sportradar access level for the requested package. Trial accounts use 'trial'; production customers use 'production'.

params.name: language_code
params.description: Two-letter language code controlling localized text in the feed (for example, 'en' for English).

params.name: match
params.description: Optional filter that restricts the stream to a single game. Provide the fully qualified Sportradar match identifier (for example, sd:match:b9cf745b-36a1-404e-8159-78d719742a6b).

items.docs: Opens a long-lived HTTP chunked connection that streams real-time NHL game event details. Heartbeat messages are sent every five seconds when no new events are available.
